name: Implement durable-first scheduler promotion from PGlite to Valkey
description: Implement the PGlite → XADD → record stream id / enqueue state → ZREM sequence for sorted-set promotion. The critical invariant: a sorted-set promotion cannot disappear work if the process crashes between durable selection and Valkey enqueue. Query PGlite for due work, write attempt-start durable state, XADD to Valkey stream, record the stream ID in PGlite, then ZREM from the sorted set.
